effects.name: VHS magnetic tape stage
effects.adaptation: Port of the stAnalogVhs magnetic-tape stage and its bounded hash and RGB/YCbCr helpers from Three.js TSL into the existing WebGL GLSL ShaderPass. The PowerShot package, renderer, demo, camera ISP, Bayer pipeline, JPEG stage, film pipeline and WebGPU adapters are not included.
adaptedAlgorithms: RGB to YCbCr and inverse conversion
Seven-tap horizontal luma low-pass with center-preserving preemphasis and weak ringing
Horizontal chroma bandwidth reduction with asymmetric chroma delay
Four-line correlated time-base error with smooth temporal interpolation and quarter-pixel timing steps
Bottom-region magnetic head-switch disturbance and phase noise
Sparse field-row and finite-segment dropouts with localized chroma loss
localChanges: Nine horizontal texture samples for the full tape stage, reusing broad samples for the weak projection glow
Pixel offsets use a virtual 360-line signal grid independent of CSS pixels and device pixel ratio
Converted upstream top-down tape coordinates for a bottom-up WebGL fullscreen quad
Narrowed head-switch disturbance to approximately the bottom eight percent of the picture
Reduced continuous CRT grille, scan contrast and phosphor ghosts so magnetic-tape damage leads the look
Protected undamaged true blacks and retained a clean central luma core for projected Chinese type
Preserved pause freezing, zero-intensity bypass, reduced-motion handling and the existing analog API
